high_level_description: This image is a promotional post from an Instagram account, specifically from the user "gabriellademetriades," who has posted it 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a model wearing a flowing, off-white dress with a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress appears to be part of a collection by the brand "deme." The model is also wearing black gloves that extend up to her elbows. The background is minimalistic, with a plain white wall and a light-colored floor, which helps to highlight the dress.
